inlines.text: Decide whether these shapes are similar. Remember that two shapes are similar if:
All corresponding sides are in equal ratio.

spec.description: Paired upright triangles, smaller left and larger right. Decorative source colours replaced by black.
spec.mathematics: Corresponding sides 8 and 24, 7 and 21, 8.7 and 26.1; corresponding angles 70°, 50°, 60°.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens only; ratio calculations belong to answers.

children.prompt: All angles the same? Yes | No

answer.worked: Corresponding angles are $70^\circ$, $50^\circ$ and $60^\circ$ in both triangles.

children.prompt: All sides in equal ratio? Yes | No

answer.worked: Corresponding angles are equal and corresponding sides are in the same ratio, so the triangles are similar.

spec.description: Paired oblique quadrilaterals with corresponding vertices in the same orientation; black ordinary outlines.
spec.mathematics: Clockwise angles from upper left: 38°, 127°, 55°, 140°. Corresponding clockwise sides: 14,9,10,12 and 21,13.5,15,18.

children.prompt: All angles the same? Yes | No

answer.worked: The corresponding angles are $38^\circ$, $127^\circ$, $55^\circ$ and $140^\circ$ in both figures.

children.prompt: All sides in equal ratio? Yes | No

answer.worked: Corresponding angles are equal and all corresponding side ratios are $1.5$, so the figures are similar.

spec.description: Paired pentagons with the same winding and corresponding angle positions; smaller left, larger right.
spec.mathematics: Clockwise sides from top: 4,8,4,2,6 and 5,10,5,2.5,7.5. Clockwise angles from upper left: 141°,60°,99°,140°,100°.

answer.short: Similar; corresponding angles are equal and all side ratios are $1.25$.
answer.worked:
$\dfrac{5}{4}=1.25,\quad \dfrac{10}{8}=1.25,\quad \dfrac{5}{4}=1.25.$

$\dfrac{2.5}{2}=1.25,\quad \dfrac{7.5}{6}=1.25.$

All corresponding angles are equal and all corresponding sides are in the same ratio, so the pentagons are similar.

spec.description: Paired upright house-shaped pentagons with matching angle labels and bottom right-angle markers.
spec.mathematics: Left roof sides 3, vertical sides 2, base 4; right roof sides 6, vertical sides 3, base 8. Apex 74°, shoulders 143°, bottom corners 90°.

answer.short: Not similar; the corresponding side ratios differ.
answer.worked:
$\dfrac{6}{3}=2$ and $\dfrac{8}{4}=2$, while $\dfrac{3}{2}=1.5$.

The corresponding sides are not all in the same ratio, so the pentagons are not similar.

spec.description: Differently oriented right triangles, with cross and filled-dot correspondence cues inside the indicated corners.
spec.mathematics: ABC has AC=12 cm, CB=5 cm, AB=13 cm and right angle C. EFD has EF=10 cm, FD=24 cm, ED=26 cm and right angle F. A corresponds to D and B to E.
spec.answerVisibility: Side lengths, vertex labels and correspondence cues are permanent givens.

answer.worked:
The matching angle cues show equal corresponding angles.

$\dfrac{24}{12}=2,\quad\dfrac{10}{5}=2,\quad\dfrac{26}{13}=2.$

Corresponding angles are equal and corresponding sides are in the same ratio, so the triangles are similar.

spec.description: Two differently rotated squares. Larger square has single equality ticks; smaller square has double equality ticks. All corners have right-angle markers.
spec.mathematics: Larger square vertices A,B,C,D; smaller square vertices G,F,E,H. No numerical side lengths.
spec.answerVisibility: Equality ticks and right-angle markers are givens.

answer.worked: All angles are $90^\circ$. Each square has four equal sides, so the ratio of corresponding side lengths is the same for every side. Therefore the squares are similar.

spec.description: Rotated rectangles with all vertex labels, right-angle markers and distinct opposite-side equality tick families.
spec.mathematics: ABCD: BC=5 m, DC=2 m; AB/DC single ticks, AD/BC double ticks. EFGH: FG=11 m, GH=4 m; EF/GH triple ticks, FG/EH quadruple ticks.

answer.worked:
All corresponding angles are $90^\circ$.

$\dfrac{11}{5}=2.2,\quad \dfrac{4}{2}=2.$

The long-side and short-side ratios differ, so the rectangles are not similar.

spec.description: Differently oriented parallelograms with midpoint parallel-arrow families and open-circle/filled-dot angle correspondence cues.
spec.mathematics: Left: sloping side 15 cm, base 5 cm; horizontal sides single arrows, sloping sides double arrows. Right GFEH: FE=2 cm, HE=6 cm; horizontal sides double arrows, sloping sides single arrows. Left bottom-left corresponds to G, left bottom-right to H.
spec.answerVisibility: All markings and lengths are givens.

answer.worked:
The matching angle cues show equal corresponding angles.

$\dfrac{15}{6}=2.5,\quad \dfrac{5}{2}=2.5.$

Opposite sides of each parallelogram are equal, so all corresponding sides have this ratio. Therefore the parallelograms are similar.
